$comment: K5 of the video-ads skill pack's docs/creator-split.md, which the creator-program skill pack builds as `crp compute roster --json` (branch m1-roster, scripts/compute_roster.py). The body is that verb's document. K5's text names `creator_ref`; the verb prints `creator` and also tier, script_id and permission_expired: both creator keys are optional here until the two packs settle one (README, 'Open points'). The creator's pay is not in this contract on purpose.
title: creators.roster/1
description: The creator roster as other packs read it: one row per collaboration, with its code, the permission and terms, and the ads that run the content. creator-program writes it; video-ads reads it to trace an ad to a scenario and to refuse more spend on an ad whose permission lapsed.
x-rules: No fee, fee basis, currency or commission is a key of this document: what a creator was paid is creator-program's own.
Keys only grow; a missing key is a failure on the reader's side, a key the reader does not know is ignored.
A creator's name never appears: a roster's handle as it is, a workbook creator only as the stable pseudonym <personal:sha8>.

market.description: The market the roster is for, when the producer has markets.

as_of.description: The day permission_expired was judged against, YYYY-MM-DD.

rows.description: One row per collaboration, ordered by collab_id.

collab_id.description: The collaboration's id, unique in the roster.

creator_ref.description: K5's name for the creator: the stable pseudonym <personal:sha8> for a workbook creator.

creator.description: What the verb prints today for the creator: a roster's handle as it is, a workbook creator only as the pseudonym.

tier.description: The creator's tier, a to e; creator-program's word.

scenario_id.description: The brief's scenario the content serves (SC plus digits).

script_id.description: The script the content was made from.

code.description: The creator's coupon or discount code, when there is one.

ads_code.description: The code the ad carries so a report row finds this collaboration.

label.description: The collaboration's label in the client's own words.

posted_on.description: The day the content was posted, YYYY-MM-DD.

permission_expires.description: The day the permission to run the content as an ad lapses, YYYY-MM-DD; null when none is recorded.

permission_expired.description: True when the permission lapsed before as_of: an ad whose permission lapsed is never proposed for more spend.

partnership_term.description: The partnership's term, in the client's words.

assets_term.description: The terms on the content as an asset, in the client's words.

ad_ids.description: The platform ad ids that run the content, as text; empty when none does.

counts.description: Totals of rows: collabs, with_code, with_ads, permission_expired.

with_ads.description: Collaborations with at least one ad.

permission_expired.description: Collaborations whose permission lapsed before as_of.

meta.description: The kit's meta block (window, sources, stale, evidence_level) as every compute --json document carries it.
